evals.name: gate-4-5-block-on-uncovered-callsites
evals.prompt: commit 하려는데 Gate 4.5 가 BLOCK 됐어. fix-scope-cache.jsonl 에 callsite 3곳이 있는데 staged 파일에는 2곳밖에 없대. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: Gate 4.5 BLOCK 메시지 확인 후 두 가지 선택지 제시: (1) 누락된 callsite 도 수정, (2) commit body 에 의도적 skip 명시. KZK_GATE45_SKIP=1 env 로 bypass 가능.

assertions.text: Response cites Gate 4.5 BLOCK condition: callsite list ⊄ git diff --cached --name-only per §Gate 4.5
Response references .kzk-harness/fix-scope-cache.jsonl as the cache source for callsite list
Response presents both resolution options: (1) modify the missing callsite, (2) document intentional skip in commit body
Response mentions KZK_GATE45_SKIP=1 env var as the bypass mechanism with note to document the reason
Response includes or references the exact BLOCK message format: 'Gate 4.5: callsite N곳 중 M곳 미수정'
